notes:
Summary: enterprise SaaS KB provider evaluating Redwood hosted API for primary retrieval + reranking path. Strong focus on embeddings + cheap reranker to minimize token spend.

Context: ArchiveBeam runs a multi-tenant knowledge base used by large SaaS customers (support + internal search). Current stack: in-house ES + Faiss hybrid; looking to move to managed hosted vectors + lightweight reranker to reduce ops and cost. Typical index scale target: 0.5M–2M documents; expected peak read QPS: 500–1200 depending on seasonality.

Latency & cost targets (from PO):
- 95th-pct end-to-end time (embedding + nearest neighbor + rerank): <= 120ms, ideally <80ms for search flows
- Cost per query budget: target <$0.002 token-equivalent (strict for bottom-line economics)

Model preferences & routing:
- Prefer 1536-d embeddings (or 1024 if cost forces tradeoff).
- Reranker: small cross-encoder (distil-BERT / 6-8M param small model) candidate; fallback to cheap lexical or sparse scoring when under heavy load.
- Need ability to route to lower-cost model variant automatically for burst traffic.

Security/compliance notes:
- SSO/SAML required for admin console.
- SOC2 attestation mandatory.
- KMS integration for key control; audit logs for indexing events.

POC so far:
- Jan 18: discovery + infra review (FF id ff_20260118_abe3).
- Feb 1: ingest script exchanged (drive doc), initial 500k doc sample indexed locally.
- Feb 9: first perf run vs Redwood demo model (fireflies ff_20260209_poccall) — functional pass but 95th-pct ~160ms with default config.
- Feb 23: Redwood suggested config: batching 16, 512-d embeddings with quantization, KV cache enabled for hot prefixes.
- Mar 02: internal load test: sustained 800 QPS for 10m against current infra; looking to repeat with Redwood hosted endpoint.

Quote from Head of Search (Lena Patel): "If we can't get sub-80ms 95th on typical queries we won't be able to move high-volume customers. Cost-per-query is equally make-or-break."

Open asks for Redwood:
- Provide recommended embedding dim vs cost trade table + quantization profiles.
- Run a 2-week POC: index 1.2M docs, simulate 500–1k QPS, provide latency/cost telemetry.
- Confirm routing/fallback policies and estimated additional cost for reranker calls.

Sales notes (AE):
- Highly engaged; procurement window Q2.
- Competitive set: evaluating Pinecone managed store + in-house FAISS + custom reranker vs Redwood hosted path.
- Legal wants SOC2 + data processing addendum before pilot with customer data.

Internal recommended next steps:
- Diego to schedule perf POC for week of 2026-03-15.
- Provide baseline config + expected unit economics (cost per 1k queries) by 2026-03-08.
- Prep security FAQ notes for legal (link above).
